scope: Actual disposable Linux isolation and metrics-only capacity rehearsal; hosted activation blocked
evidence_revision: Evidence-only descendant of runtime_source; no runtime execution of this documentation revision is claimed.

artifact.aggregate_policy: No raw logs, labels, secrets, inboxes or repetitive sample rows; phase/service summaries retained.

candidate_counter_readiness.source: Prometheus v3.9.1 tsdb/head.go CounterVec; head_append.go Commit binds type children.

metric_reconciliation.settlement_rule: No producer; queue empty and sent/stored stable for >=2 repeated observations after >=6s, deadline15s.
metric_reconciliation.failure_counter_semantics: Failed send attempt-points can include retries; not a lost-point count. Enqueue failures/refusals are separate; missing baseline delta remains null.

controlled_export_failure_attempts.semantics: Cumulative attempt/refusal/enqueue counters; never interpreted as unique lost points.

projection.app_storage_accounting: PGDATA includes WAL; WAL is a reported subset, never added twice. Actual allocated upload bytes include directories.
projection.architecture_equivalence: unproven; no linear x64-vCPU to ARM-OCPU conversion

startup_budget_mib.logs_backup_disk: separate 1GiB logs + aligned backup + >=4GiB/20% free reserve

projection.interpretation: Short run, fixed offered rate; WAL allocation/compaction noise makes linear growth uncertain. No trace/log storage or application SDK overhead measured. Hosted activation blocked; #103 platform-specific retest required.

acceptance_outcomes.AC1: Observed: distinct projects/DB identities/secrets/leaf keys/volumes/networks; production validation, trusted HTTPS and host-only browser cookies.
acceptance_outcomes.AC2: Observed: normal auth and authenticated STARTTLS sinks; own private reads; anonymous/cross-token/cookie/Origin/browser denial.
acceptance_outcomes.AC3: Observed: all dev write/migration/reset/startup-failure/secret-replacement preservation checks, network/DB credential denial, prod recreate/down-up persistence.
acceptance_outcomes.AC4: Observed: pinned official multiarch images; one Collector/Prometheus/Grafana; synthetic stored values and authenticated numeric Grafana query.
acceptance_outcomes.AC5: Observed: all five actual phases, fixed-rate business reads/OTLP/Grafana load and actual per-field timing/service/runner/storage measurements.
acceptance_outcomes.AC6: Observed: bounded queue/retry/caps, controlled outage/loss and fresh recovery, real disk growth and explicit short-run retention projections.
acceptance_outcomes.AC7: Local measurements/budgets/stops recorded. Hosted ARM activation remains blocked; no architecture or unmeasured SDK/trace/log fit claim.
acceptance_outcomes.AC8: Reviewed future preservation/cutover plan in _docs/rehearsal101.md; no live cutover/backup/restore/reset/promotion performed.
acceptance_outcomes.AC9: Actual source/run/hash/artifact/cleanup plus durable aggregates recorded; final independent evidence/publication QA remains required.

limits: Narrow synthetic account/photo read workload, not production traffic.
Metrics-only candidate; actual SDK, trace/log storage/export and future workload overhead excluded; remeasure under #103.
Short storage run, allocation/compaction noise; retention is asynchronous and not a quota/soak proof.
No x64 vCPU to ARM OCPU equivalence; reserve >=1.5 GiB and 20% CPU plus disk/backups before any hosted decision.
Docker host administrators are outside the isolation boundary.
No new hosted environment, external SMTP/notification or live-resource/secret transition.

retention_unit_clarification.explanation: The original controller report uses an incorrect decimal byte label. Prometheus 3.9.1 parses the actual MB flag in powers of two. Original report/hash and measured growth are unchanged.

candidate_configuration_as_reported.notes: Block retention is asynchronous; WAL/head add disk. Projections are not a retention soak or quota proof.
candidate_configuration_as_reported.endpoints: loopback-only fixed control relay on own ingress bridge; backend services internal-only; no DB publication or external export
candidate_configuration_as_reported.relay_egress_boundary: Relay has ingress bridge default route; code forwards only four hardcoded internal destinations. No claim of network-enforced relay egress denial.
candidate_configuration_as_reported.components: otlp/http, memory_limiter, batch, prometheusremotewrite; metrics only
